page_header: Section A — Very Short Answer Question

steps.label: Definition of flora
lines: Flora is the actual account of the habitat and
distribution of plants of a given area.

lines.text: Flora — the plant record of a given area

steps.why: The definition names the two things a flora records — where the plants live (habitat) and where they occur (distribution) — for one given area.
common_mistakes: Writing that flora means only 'plants'. A flora is the written account of the plants of an area.
Mixing up flora with fauna. Fauna is the animal list; flora is the plant list.
steps.memory_tip: FLora has the L of pLants; FAuna has the A of Animals — match the letters.
steps.margin_note: Two lines of definition carry both marks.

steps.label: What a flora is used for
lines: A flora helps in the correct identification
of the plants found in that area.
steps.why: One line on its use shows why floras are written — they are the reference for identifying the plants of that area.
common_mistakes: Writing a long note on all the taxonomical aids. The question asks about flora alone.
steps.memory_tip: Area, account, identification — a flora is written area-wise and used to identify.
steps.margin_note: Optional line. The definition above already carries both marks.

insider_note: Examiners look for three words in the definition — habitat, distribution and 'a given area'; keep all three.
